intelligence.essence: Whatever sits in the showcase — video, image, or text — sits inside a lit-up intelligent board inside the frame. Never a bare picture, video, or text on the page. The board is alive: light flows around its edge, it moves and breathes, and on touch it presses in and out and lights up — exactly like the Hub's intelligent boards. Text becomes elevated boards in that same area — three, two, or one, however the words display best. The player stays a real, pro player: bar at the top of the frame, the logo and a button where the playlist was. And the module does double work: the framed showcase IS a post — a framed image, video, or text in the feed shows up as a smart block, with only the social sharing block added underneath. For this presentation the social block is NOT added — but it is the same module, built once, used twice.
